RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Seattle operates under a mayor-council form of government. The Mayor and City Attorney are elected city-wide. The City Council consists of nine members; seven are elected by district, and two are elected at-large (Positions 8 and 9). The Seattle Municipal Court has seven elected judges. Information regarding the Presiding Judge was prioritized from the most recent official court website statement.
